title: Annual Live Births by Sex & Ethnicity
description: Annual number of births with signs of life upon delivery, with breakdowns by sex and ethnic group.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 since the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes ('both'), male ('male') or female ('female')

fields.name: ethnicity
fields.title: Ethnicity
fields.description: [Categorical] All ethnic groups ('overall'), Malay ('bumi_malay'), other Bumiputera ('bumi_other'), Chinese ('chinese'), Indian ('indian'), other citizens ('other_citizen'), or non-citizen residents ('other_noncitizen')

fields.name: abs
fields.title: Live Births
fields.description: [Integer] Number of live births in that year

fields.name: rate
fields.title: Crude Birth Rate
fields.description: [Float] Number of live births per 1000 population

methodology: A live birth is a birth with signs of life upon delivery, even if only for a short while. The data on live births in Malaysia is tabulated based on information reported during the births registration process, specifically in the in Register of Birth Form (JPN.LM01). For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definition, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).
caveat: This data is derived based on births registered with JPN. Accordingly, if a birth is not registered with JPN (for instance, if a foreigner chooses to register their child in their home country, or if a resident in a remote area does not register the birth of their child), it will not count in this dataset.
publication:
There are two dashboards where you can explore this (and related) data more interactively:
 - data.gov.my features a dashboard on [Birthday Popularity](https://data.gov.my/dashboard/birthday-explorer)
 - OpenDOSM features a dashboard on [Population & Vital Statistics](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/population)
